description: Returns a status page's incidents, newest first, 10 per call, resolved ones included; pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next 10. An incident shows on the page while it is both pinned and active. getStatusPage also returns the ones showing now.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, for the next page

slug.description: The status page slug. Find slugs with listStatusPages.

name: listIncidents

content.description: Markdown, as the status page renders it

createdDate.description: UTC, as Uptime Kuma stores it

lastUpdatedDate.description: UTC, as Uptime Kuma stores it

pin.description: Shown on the status page while also active

style.description: Banner style: info, warning, danger, primary, light, dark

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last

total.description: Incidents on this page in all

title: List Incidents
